DeterminationBasis: Existing T02 cases establish deterministic identity continuity, changed-object distinguishability, failure to establish required identity and canonicalisation completeness, but none directly requires each consequentially relied-upon object to identify the time or temporal state relevant to its creation or applicability.

T02-006 establishes completeness of canonical byte-production rules and T02-001 establishes stable identity under a declared identity method, but neither directly tests that the implementation explicitly declares the hash algorithm used to identify the canonical byte representation.
